purpose: Predict whether reasoning corrects an incorrect fast-mode answer (rescue event).

feature_schema.name: fast_hidden_state
feature_schema.structure: 2,048 float values from the final transformer hidden state at the fast prompt readout position, in model output order

probability_output: Use sigmoid(decision_function) for class 1; predict_proba column for classes[1].

export_notes.version_note: The source pickle emitted scikit-learn InconsistentVersionWarning on load. The fitted arrays were exported directly and matched the loaded pipeline; JSON inference uses the explicitly stored affine scaler and logistic parameters.
